name: Seiryo Kaikan
accessSummary: Nagatacho Station (Tokyo Metro Yurakucho, Hanzomon and Namboku Lines) Exit 6: 3 min walk / Kokkai-gijidomae Station (Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line) Exit 5: 5 min walk / Tameike-sanno Station (Tokyo Metro Namboku Line) Exit 5: 5 min walk / Akasaka-mitsuke Station (Tokyo Metro Ginza and Marunouchi Lines) Exit 11: 7 min walk
hours: Opens at 8:45. Booking slots are morning 9:00-12:00, afternoon 13:00-17:00 and evening 17:30-21:00 (if consecutive slots are booked, the time between slots can also be used; usage time includes setup and cleanup time). Reservations are accepted 9:00-18:00.

rooms.name: Hall
rooms.note: 2F/3F. Capacity 400 (193 fixed seats, 207 movable seats). 364 seats when the lift stage is used. Piano (Steinway B-211), sound and lighting equipment available.

rooms.name: Multipurpose Hall (4F Restaurant)
rooms.note: 4F. Capacity 100. 1 wired microphone, 1 wireless microphone and more. Projector and screen available for rent. Can be used for receptions, alumni gatherings, parties, seminars and so on.

rooms.name: Conference Room D (1D in the price list)
rooms.note: 1F. Capacity 18 (7 tables, 18 chairs, 1 whiteboard). Because it is directly below the hall stage, sound from the hall may leak in. Has a video monitor for checking the hall stage.

rooms.name: Conference Room E
rooms.note: 1F. Capacity 24 (8 tables, 24 chairs, 1 whiteboard, 1 screen, Wi-Fi available).

rooms.name: Conference Room F
rooms.note: 1F. Capacity 30 (10 tables, 30 chairs, 1 whiteboard, 1 screen, Wi-Fi available).

rooms.name: Conference Room 3A
rooms.note: 3F. Capacity 30 (10 tables, 30 chairs, 1 whiteboard, 1 screen, Wi-Fi available).

rooms.name: Conference Room 3B
rooms.note: 3F. Capacity 24 (8 tables, 24 chairs, 1 whiteboard, 1 screen, Wi-Fi available).

rooms.name: Conference Room 4AB
rooms.note: 4F. Capacity 48 (16 tables, 48 chairs, 2 whiteboards, 1 screen, Wi-Fi available). When Rooms 4A and 4B are used together, 1 wired microphone is lent free of charge.

rooms.name: Japanese-style Room (Washitsu)
rooms.note: 3F. 12 tatami mats, capacity 12 (low tables, floor cushions, 1 whiteboard).

rooms.name: Private Room (Koshitsu)
rooms.note: 3F. Capacity 4 (1 round table, 4 chairs). Has a video monitor for checking the hall stage. Suitable as a waiting room for the hall.

ops.prevDaySetup: Only when a performance is held in the hall, the price list has a "Setup / Rehearsal" category (general use, tax included. Weekdays: morning 46,970 yen / afternoon 66,990 yen / evening 83,380 yen; Sat, Sun and holidays: morning 54,340 yen / afternoon 83,380 yen / evening 88,660 yen. Revised October 1, 2024). Usage time for conference rooms and the hall also includes setup and cleanup time. (Source: https://www.seiryokai.org/kaikan/price.html)
ops.loadingHours: The venue opens at 8:45. When bringing in food, drinks, fresh flowers or luggage from outside, load in and out within the booked time. For hall use, a prior meeting is held, around 1 month in advance. When sending luggage by courier, notify the office in advance of the contents, number of items and delivery time, and write "c/o Seiryo Kaikan, date of use, group name, contact person's name" in the recipient field. (Source: https://www.seiryokai.org/kaikan/info.html)
ops.vehicleRules: Only when loading in and out hall equipment, up to about 2 medium-sized vehicles can be parked. Always consult in advance. (Source: https://www.seiryokai.org/kaikan/info.html)
ops.parking: There is no parking lot, and in principle there is no parking space for users. Hall organizers guide visitors not to come by car. (Source: https://www.seiryokai.org/kaikan/info.html)
ops.waitingRooms: The hall facility fee does not include waiting rooms, which must be booked separately. Conference Room D (39m2, 18 people) is directly below the hall stage and has a video monitor, making it suitable as a waiting room or preparation room for the hall. The Private Room (10m2, 4 people, 3F) is also suitable as a hall waiting room. (Source: https://www.seiryokai.org/kaikan/info.html)
ops.catering: Food and drink at the 4F Multipurpose Hall is provided by the 4F restaurant "Collina della Stella". Private-hire parties are available from 30 people, and food and drink menus can be discussed from about 7,000 yen per person (excluding tax and service charge); depending on the number of guests, a separate serving staff fee applies. Use of the Multipurpose Hall with food and drink costs 12,650 yen per hour (general, tax included, 3 hours or more). When bringing in food and drink from outside, load in and out within the booked time. (Source: https://www.seiryokai.org/kaikan/restaurant.html)
ops.restaurants: The 4F has the restaurant "Collina della Stella". It serves lunch on weekdays (Mon-Fri) 11:30-14:30 (buffet 2,600 yen tax included, 2-hour limit). Private-hire plans for parties, receptions and alumni gatherings are available, on weekdays from 15:30 (negotiable) to 20:00, and on Sat, Sun and holidays from 10:00 to 20:00. (Source: https://www.seiryokai.org/kaikan/restaurant.html)
